name: seomarkup-structured-data-schema-inspector
description: Local-only Chrome extension for Schema.org, SEO, social metadata, and tracking-tag inspection.

scripts.check: node --check extension/analyzer.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.package: rm -f dist/seomarkup-v0.1.0.zip public/downloads/seomarkup-v0.1.0.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/seomarkup-v0.1.0.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && cp ../dist/seomarkup-v0.1.0.zip ../public/downloads/seomarkup-v0.1.0.zip
